newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent drops, NYMEX falls after API data.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent drops, NYMEX falls after API data.

text.p: Brent crude futures were lower by late afternoon on Thursday in line with NYMEX weakness after the API data.
The NYMEX March contract, which expires on Friday, was down 22 cents at $22.57 per barrel from New York, while April was down 18 cents at $22.15.

Brokers said the contracts faced heavy outright selling in the wake of API data, which showed a slightly bigger than expected build for some players of 3.12 million barrels. However, others said the build was in line.
By late afternoon March had notched up volume of 1,528 lots and April 1,428.
Brokers said players rolled out of positions in the March as the API data did not offer any surprises.
However, they said crack buying of crude against the products -- in very light volume -- knocked the products prices.
March gasoline was down 0.48 cent at 64.20 cents per gallon from New York in just 33 lots and heating oil dropped 0.34 to 59.25 on 109 lots.
April Brent was traded at $20.51, down 12 cents from London and May was traded at $20.20, down 12 cents from London.
